title: Implement effective system prompt precedence
objective: Match the original system prompt precedence rules for override, coordinator, agent, custom, default, and append prompts.
context: Go currently treats --system-prompt mostly as a full replacement.
The original has a strict precedence chain and appendSystemPrompt behavior.
SDK initialize currently acknowledges systemPrompt but does not apply it to the engine.
deliverables: Add an EffectiveSystemPrompt builder with explicit inputs for override, coordinator, agent, custom, default, and append prompts.
Make override replace all other prompt content.
Make custom replace the default prompt while still allowing append prompt.
Append appendSystemPrompt after the selected base prompt except when override is used.
Make SDK initialize systemPrompt actually configure the engine or session prompt path.
acceptance: Table-driven tests cover every precedence branch.
SDK custom system prompt changes the next query's prompt.
--system-prompt behavior is documented and tested against custom prompt semantics.
Agent and team prompt paths still compile and pass existing tests.
non_goals: Do not rewrite built-in agent prompt prose.
Do not add new CLI flags unless required for parity.
Do not implement proactive mode prompt behavior unless the existing Go runtime already supports proactive mode.
handoff_notes: This task touches shared runtime paths; keep patches small and table-test every precedence rule.
